cards.card_text: Solomon says, "He who winks the eye causes grief, and foolish lips will come to ruin." That line about foolish lips again, and with eyebrows THIS big, I couldn't wink if I tried!
cards.verse_text: A wise heart will receive commandments, but foolish lips will come to ruin. He who winks the eye causes grief, and foolish lips will come to ruin.
